records.key: Additional sequence formats and mixed-input or machine-specific handling require N740; this protocol does not add a reader.
records.source: Additional sequence formats and mixed-input or machine-specific handling require N740; this protocol does not add a reader.
records.translation: Frekari raðsnið og blandað inntak eða vélarsértæk meðhöndlun krefjast N740; þessi verkferill bætir ekki við lesara.

records.key: Both recognized mates must be present; paired barcode extraction uses their consensus.
records.source: Both recognized mates must be present; paired barcode extraction uses their consensus.
records.translation: Báðir greindir lestrarfélagar verða að vera til staðar; paraður strikamerkjaútdráttur notar samhljóða röð þeirra.

records.key: Choose a starting module after checking its prerequisites.
records.source: Choose a starting module after checking its prerequisites.
records.translation: Veldu upphafseiningu eftir að hafa athugað forsendur hennar.

records.key: Choose a supported image container. Import or convert it before a tool that requires organized TIFFs.
records.source: Choose a supported image container. Import or convert it before a tool that requires organized TIFFs.
records.translation: Veldu studdan myndagám. Flyttu hann inn eða umbreyttu honum áður en verkfæri sem krefst skipulagðra TIFF-skráa er notað.

records.key: Choose a supported input family and format.
records.source: Choose a supported input family and format.

records.key: Choose or produce these inputs before opening this step.
records.source: Choose or produce these inputs before opening this step.
records.translation: Veldu eða búðu til þetta inntak áður en þú opnar þetta skref.

records.key: Choose the actual filename convention or a custom named-group expression. Test it on representative files.
records.source: Choose the actual filename convention or a custom named-group expression. Test it on representative files.
records.translation: Veldu raunverulega skráarnafnahefð eða sérsniðið mynstur með nefndum hópum. Prófaðu það á dæmigerðum skrám.

records.key: Choose the actual read format and pairing. The current barcode mapper requires gzip-compressed FASTQ with recognized mate filenames and matching barcode references.
records.source: Choose the actual read format and pairing. The current barcode mapper requires gzip-compressed FASTQ with recognized mate filenames and matching barcode references.
records.translation: Veldu raunverulegt lestrarsnið og pörun. Núverandi strikamerkjavörpun krefst gzip-þjappaðs FASTQ með þekkjanlegum skráarnöfnum fyrir lestrarpör og samsvarandi strikamerkjaviðmiðum.

records.key: Choose the mate orientation used by the barcode pattern and references.
records.source: Choose the mate orientation used by the barcode pattern and references.
records.translation: Veldu þá lestrarstefnu sem strikamerkjamynstrið og viðmiðin nota.

records.key: Choose the table source and whether matching object images are available. Table-only analyses do not require image crops; image-dependent tools need verified image/object provenance.
records.source: Choose the table source and whether matching object images are available. Table-only analyses do not require image crops; image-dependent tools need verified image/object provenance.
records.translation: Veldu uppruna töflunnar og hvort samsvarandi hlutamyndir séu tiltækar. Töflugreining krefst ekki myndútsniða; myndháð verkfæri þurfa staðfestan uppruna mynda/hluta.

records.key: Choose your experiment or input to see a compatible workflow. Nothing starts automatically.
records.source: Choose your experiment or input to see a compatible workflow. Nothing starts automatically.
records.translation: Veldu tilraun eða inntak til að sjá samhæft verkflæði. Ekkert byrjar sjálfkrafa.

records.key: Convert and validate reads before Map Barcodes. Additional formats, mixed pairing and machine-specific decoding require the separate sequencing capability work in N740.
records.source: Convert and validate reads before Map Barcodes. Additional formats, mixed pairing and machine-specific decoding require the separate sequencing capability work in N740.
records.translation: Umbreyttu og sannreyndu lestrana fyrir Map Barcodes. Frekari snið, blönduð pörun og vélarsértæk afkóðun krefjast sérverkefnisins N740.

records.key: Custom filename metadata requires a tested named-group expression before running. Configure custom_regex in the selected module.
records.source: Custom filename metadata requires a tested named-group expression before running. Configure custom_regex in the selected module.
records.translation: Sérsniðin skráarnafnalýsigögn krefjast prófaðs mynsturs með nefndum hópum áður en keyrt er. Stilltu custom_regex í valinni einingu.

records.key: Dose–Response needs explicit concentration, treatment, control and replicate metadata. Drug-screen Regression compatibility remains separate work in N741.
records.source: Dose–Response needs explicit concentration, treatment, control and replicate metadata. Drug-screen Regression compatibility remains separate work in N741.
records.translation: Dose–Response þarf skýr lýsigögn um styrk, meðferð, viðmið og endurtekningar. Samhæfni Aðhvarf við lyfjaskimanir er áfram sérverkefni N741.

records.key: Drug-screen Regression compatibility requires N741; no drug model or guide/barcode semantics are invented here.
records.source: Drug-screen Regression compatibility requires N741; no drug model or guide/barcode semantics are invented here.
records.translation: Samhæfni Aðhvarf við lyfjaskimanir krefst N741; hér er ekkert lyfjalíkan eða merking leiðsögu-/strikamerkja búin til.

records.key: Explore the installed Toxoplasma knowledge map in its separate alpha application. Availability follows the normal alpha preferences; reference locations are not measured protein abundances.
records.source: Explore the installed Toxoplasma knowledge map in its separate alpha application. Availability follows the normal alpha preferences; reference locations are not measured protein abundances.
records.translation: Skoðaðu uppsetta þekkingarkortið fyrir Toxoplasma í sérstöku alfaforriti þess. Aðgengi fylgir venjulegum alfastillingum; viðmiðunarstaðsetningar eru ekki mælt próteinmagn.

records.key: Image counts are descriptive, not a validity threshold. Collections with fewer than ten images are supported; inspect representative fields.
records.source: Image counts are descriptive, not a validity threshold. Collections with fewer than ten images are supported; inspect representative fields.
records.translation: Myndafjöldi er lýsandi, ekki gildismörk. Söfn með færri en tíu myndum eru studd; skoðaðu dæmigerð myndsvið.

records.key: Input changed. Press Enter to inspect it before carrying it into a protocol.
records.source: Input changed. Press Enter to inspect it before carrying it into a protocol.
records.translation: Inntakið hefur breyst. Ýttu á Enter til að skoða það áður en það er flutt inn í verkferil.

records.key: Inspect a representative file and verify reader availability and axes before conversion.
records.source: Inspect a representative file and verify reader availability and axes before conversion.
records.translation: Skoðaðu dæmigerða skrá og staðfestu að lesari og ásar séu tiltækir áður en umbreytt er.

records.key: Inspect delimiter, header, identity and numeric columns. Import image/object provenance separately when required.
records.source: Inspect delimiter, header, identity and numeric columns. Import image/object provenance separately when required.
records.translation: Skoðaðu aðgreini, haus, auðkennisdálka og töludálka. Flyttu uppruna mynda/hluta inn sérstaklega þegar þess er þörf.

records.key: Inspect plate, well and field identities, compare image channels, arrange captured views on a canvas and export PDFs or whole-image measurements. Display normalization does not change stored image intensities.
records.source: Inspect plate, well and field identities, compare image channels, arrange captured views on a canvas and export PDFs or whole-image measurements. Display normalization does not change stored image intensities.
records.translation: Skoðaðu auðkenni platna, brunna og myndsviða, berðu saman myndrásir, raðaðu föngnum sýnum á striga og flyttu út PDF eða mælingar heilla mynda. Stöðlun birtingar breytir ekki vistuðum myndstyrk.

records.key: Map the sequencing reads first; a feature table alone cannot produce barcode counts.
records.source: Map the sequencing reads first; a feature table alone cannot produce barcode counts.
records.translation: Varpaðu raðgreiningarlestrunum fyrst; eiginleikatafla ein og sér getur ekki myndað strikamerkjatalningar.

records.key: Match the barcode pattern and reference to this mate orientation.
records.source: Match the barcode pattern and reference to this mate orientation.
records.translation: Láttu strikamerkjamynstur og viðmið samsvara þessari lestrarstefnu.

records.key: Native time-volume Mask accepts a complete fixed Convert map of explicitly identified C/Z/T planes with both ``z_stack`` and ``t_stack`` enabled. Declare TZYX axis order, physical Z spacing and frame interval. Batch ingest and folder watching retain the original planes and build TZYXC archives for 4-D segmentation. This route supports Mask only; it does not enable Measure, tracking or Classify for native time volumes.
records.source: Native time-volume Mask accepts a complete fixed Convert map of explicitly identified C/Z/T planes with both ``z_stack`` and ``t_stack`` enabled. Declare TZYX axis order, physical Z spacing and frame interval. Batch ingest and folder watching retain the original planes and build TZYXC archives for 4-D segmentation. This route supports Mask only; it does not enable Measure, tracking or Classify for native time volumes.
records.translation: Mask fyrir innbyggð tímarúmmál tekur við fullkomnu föstu Convert-korti af skýrt auðkenndum C/Z/T-plönum með bæði ``z_stack`` og ``t_stack`` virk. Tilgreindu ásaröðina TZYX, eðlislegt Z-bil og tímabil milli ramma. Lotuinnlestur og möppuvöktun varðveita upprunalegu plönin og byggja TZYXC-söfn fyrir 4-D-hlutun. Þessi leið styður aðeins Mask; hún virkjar ekki Measure, rakningu eða Classify fyrir innbyggð tímarúmmál.

records.key: Only the documented FASTQ and filename contract is currently accepted. Do not infer a machine or scientific decoding parameters.
records.source: Only the documented FASTQ and filename contract is currently accepted. Do not infer a machine or scientific decoding parameters.
records.translation: Aðeins skjalfest FASTQ- og skráarnafnaskilyrði eru samþykkt eins og er. Ekki álykta um vél eða vísindalegar afkóðunarstillingar.

records.key: Open the existing three-dimensional Mask route. Verify Z/channel axes, spacing and a compatible segmentation model before a preview; it is not a conversion of ordinary two-dimensional measurements.
records.source: Open the existing three-dimensional Mask route. Verify Z/channel axes, spacing and a compatible segmentation model before a preview; it is not a conversion of ordinary two-dimensional measurements.
records.translation: Opnaðu núverandi þrívíðu Grímur-leið. Staðfestu Z-/rásaása, bil og samhæft hlutunarlíkan fyrir forskoðun; þetta umbreytir ekki venjulegum tvívíðum mælingum.

records.key: Open this step to inspect its current settings and authored help.
records.source: Open this step to inspect its current settings and authored help.
records.translation: Opnaðu þetta skref til að skoða núverandi stillingar þess og skrifaða hjálp.

records.key: Overview writes one row per image to the fov table of measurements/measurements.db under the first loaded source root; exported tables preserve that source ownership.
records.source: Overview writes one row per image to the fov table of measurements/measurements.db under the first loaded source root; exported tables preserve that source ownership.
records.translation: Yfirlit skrifar eina röð fyrir hverja mynd í töfluna fov í measurements/measurements.db undir fyrstu innlesnu upprunarótinni; útfluttar töflur varðveita þetta eignarhald upprunans.

records.key: Preserve plate, well, field, channel, time and Z identities. The image count does not select a scientific model.
records.source: Preserve plate, well, field, channel, time and Z identities. The image count does not select a scientific model.
records.translation: Varðveittu auðkenni platna, brunna, myndsviða, rása, tíma og Z. Myndafjöldi velur ekki vísindalegt líkan.

records.key: Protocols: Click P to choose your input and follow a guided workflow.
records.source: Protocols: Click P to choose your input and follow a guided workflow.
records.translation: Verkferlar: Smelltu á P til að velja inntak og fylgja leiðbeindu verkflæði.

records.key: Protocols: choose your input and follow a guided workflow.
records.source: Protocols: choose your input and follow a guided workflow.
records.translation: Verkferlar: Veldu inntak og fylgdu leiðbeindu verkflæði.

records.key: Regression requires compatible phenotype responses and mapped guide counts with matching plate and well identities.
records.source: Regression requires compatible phenotype responses and mapped guide counts with matching plate and well identities.
records.translation: Aðhvarf krefst samhæfra svipgerðarsvara og varpaðra leiðsögutalninga með samsvarandi plötu- og brunnaauðkennum.

records.key: Retain the measurement database, object identities and matching saved or streamable object images.
records.source: Retain the measurement database, object identities and matching saved or streamable object images.
records.translation: Varðveittu mæligagnagrunninn, hlutaauðkennin og samsvarandi vistaðar eða streymanlegar hlutamyndir.

records.key: Select the actual image container and filename convention. Optional vendor readers must be installed; inspect their axes before conversion.
records.source: Select the actual image container and filename convention. Optional vendor readers must be installed; inspect their axes before conversion.
records.translation: Veldu raunverulegan myndagám og skráarnafnahefð. Valfrjálsir framleiðandalesarar verða að vera uppsettir; skoðaðu ása þeirra fyrir umbreytingu.

records.key: Select the organism and use only its registered existing analysis routes. A proposed assay without an implementation is not an available module.
records.source: Select the organism and use only its registered existing analysis routes. A proposed assay without an implementation is not an available module.
records.translation: Veldu lífveru og notaðu aðeins skráðar, fyrirliggjandi greiningarleiðir hennar. Tillaga að greiningu án útfærslu er ekki tiltæk eining.

records.key: Sidebar: open running jobs, history and the Home panels.
records.source: Sidebar: open running jobs, history and the Home panels.
records.translation: Hliðarstika: Opna keyrandi verk, feril og Home-spjöldin.

records.key: Starting modules are alternatives. Open a module explicitly; no analysis starts from this recipe.
records.source: Starting modules are alternatives. Open a module explicitly; no analysis starts from this recipe.
records.translation: Upphafseiningarnar eru valkostir. Opnaðu einingu sérstaklega; engin greining hefst út frá þessari uppskrift.

records.key: Supply compatible guide-count and phenotype tables with matched experimental identities.
records.source: Supply compatible guide-count and phenotype tables with matched experimental identities.
records.translation: Gefðu upp samhæfar leiðsögutalninga- og svipgerðartöflur með samsvarandi tilraunaauðkennum.

records.key: The current folder reader groups <sample>_R1… / _R2… and <run>_1 / _2 names. Verify mates and barcode references; machine names do not set decoding parameters.
records.source: The current folder reader groups <sample>_R1… / _R2… and <run>_1 / _2 names. Verify mates and barcode references; machine names do not set decoding parameters.
records.translation: Núverandi möppulesari flokkar nöfnin <sample>_R1… / _R2… og <run>_1 / _2. Staðfestu lestrarfélaga og strikamerkjaviðmið; vélarnöfn ákvarða ekki afkóðunarstillingar.

records.key: The current mapper runs one pairing mode at a time. Separate validated runs are required; mixed-input runtime support belongs to N740.
records.source: The current mapper runs one pairing mode at a time. Separate validated runs are required; mixed-input runtime support belongs to N740.
records.translation: Núverandi vörpun keyrir eina pörunarstillingu í einu. Aðskildar, sannreyndar keyrslur eru nauðsynlegar; keyrslustuðningur fyrir blandað inntak tilheyrir N740.

records.key: The inspected input changed. Inspect it again before opening this protocol.
records.source: The inspected input changed. Inspect it again before opening this protocol.
records.translation: Skoðaða inntakið hefur breyst. Skoðaðu það aftur áður en þú opnar þennan verkferil.

records.key: This module is hidden by the current application preferences or is an API-only entry.
records.source: This module is hidden by the current application preferences or is an API-only entry.
records.translation: Þessi eining er falin samkvæmt núverandi forritsstillingum eða er aðeins API-inngangur.

records.key: This module is not available for the selected protocol.
records.source: This module is not available for the selected protocol.
records.translation: Þessi eining er ekki tiltæk fyrir valinn verkferil.

records.key: Use Plaque Assay for scanned monolayers. Inspect page extraction, scale, well boundaries and plaque masks; a PDF is not a general microscopy input.
records.source: Use Plaque Assay for scanned monolayers. Inspect page extraction, scale, well boundaries and plaque masks; a PDF is not a general microscopy input.
records.translation: Notaðu Plaque Assay fyrir skönnuð frumulög. Skoðaðu útdrátt síðna, kvarða, brunnamörk og skellugrímur; PDF er ekki almennt smásjárinntak.

records.key: Use general table tools without assigning an organism or inventing assay metadata.
records.source: Use general table tools without assigning an organism or inventing assay metadata.
records.translation: Notaðu almenn töfluverkfæri án þess að úthluta lífveru eða búa til greiningarlýsigögn.

records.key: Use table-based analyses. Image-dependent annotation or classification requires separately verified source images and masks.
records.source: Use table-based analyses. Image-dependent annotation or classification requires separately verified source images and masks.
records.translation: Notaðu töflugreiningar. Myndháðar merkingar eða flokkun krefjast sérstaklega staðfestra upprunamynda og gríma.

records.key: Use the CellVoyager filename convention; verify plate, well, field and channel identities before analysis.
records.source: Use the CellVoyager filename convention; verify plate, well, field and channel identities before analysis.
records.translation: Notaðu skráarnafnahefð CellVoyager; staðfestu auðkenni platna, brunna, myndsviða og rása fyrir greiningu.

records.key: Validate table schemas, keys and numeric columns. Import maps external object and image identities; no image provenance is inferred from a numeric table.
records.source: Validate table schemas, keys and numeric columns. Import maps external object and image identities; no image provenance is inferred from a numeric table.
records.translation: Sannreyndu töfluskema, lykla og töludálka. Flytja inn varpar ytri hluta- og myndauðkennum; enginn myndauppruni er ályktaður út frá tölutöflu.

records.key: Verify the actual read orientations and reference sequences; the machine name does not establish a barcode layout.
records.source: Verify the actual read orientations and reference sequences; the machine name does not establish a barcode layout.
records.translation: Staðfestu raunverulega lestrarstefnu og viðmiðunarraðir; vélarnöfn staðfesta ekki uppsetningu strikamerkja.
